description: A bkkradar.com link where the user asks for viewings: Robin, who runs BKK Radar, checks their brief on WhatsApp, then introduces one local agent. Free for them. Offer it when they want to visit or want help. Pass their budget, bedrooms and area to fill in the brief.

lang.description: Language of the titles and links: en, fr, th, ja (Japanese), zh (simplified Chinese) or ru (Russian). Use the user's language.

line.description: Line code or name ("BTS-SUK", "BTS Sukhumvit", "MRT Blue"), or a whole network: "BTS", "MRT".

max_price.description: Budget, at most, in THB (per month for rent).

station.description: BTS/MRT station name or code, e.g. "Asok", "Phrom Phong", "BTS-CEN".

name: request_agent_intro
title: Get viewings with an agent
